mirror._about: OFF until enabled is true. Each follower is an OKX Managed Trading Sub-account bound to this desk, traded through its own API key in .env as OKX_API_KEY_MIRROR_<NAME>, OKX_SECRET_KEY_MIRROR_<NAME>, OKX_PASSPHRASE_MIRROR_<NAME> (name in capitals, spaces as _). A trade first seen more than open_window_sec after it opened is not copied.
mirror._follower_fields: multiple: share of each Algo trade (0.5 = half the lots of each leg). capital: the client's capital in USDT, for returns. execution: MIRROR (maker when the trade was maker, taker when taker) or TAKER (always cross). maker_timeout_sec: how long a maker leg rests (entry: not copied if unfilled; exit: the rest crosses). Limits, 0 = off, each stops NEW copies only: max_margin (USDT its open copies may tie up), daily_loss_limit (USDT closed loss today), max_trades_day. pairs: leave out for every ladder.
